contentBlocks.body: Partial<T> is useful for patch-style updates where callers provide only the fields that changed. Merge the patch into the existing object and return a new object when state should stay immutable.

choices: Every Profile field is required twice
payload.explanation: Partial<T> creates a type where each property from T is optional.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Merge a profile patch into the existing profile and return a new object.

payload.text: Where Partial<T> makes every property optional, ____<T> makes every property required.
